leg_verdict_rules.3_SCHEMATIC: PASS if schematic artifact exists and nets coherent; FAIL if missing MCU/sensors/power
leg_verdict_rules.4_SPICE: PASS if OP 3V3 within 5% of 3.3 V (3.135–3.465 V); WARN if tool degrade; FAIL if out of band
leg_verdict_rules.5_PCB_LAYOUT: PASS if board + DRC clean or WARN-only; FAIL if DRC error or no board
leg_verdict_rules.6_ANTENNA_RF: PASS if openEMS or analytic design for 2.4 GHz IFA and GPS patch; WARN on analytic degrade; SKIP only if both paths unavailable with documented reason (openEMS installed at specify time)
leg_verdict_rules.7_FIRMWARE: PASS if fw_build produces ELF; FAIL if build fails
leg_verdict_rules.8_RENODE_SITL: PASS if fw_sim_run + fw_verify_board; SKIP only if Renode unprovisioned — fw_status showed renode found=true at specify, so SKIP requires failed/unavailable run evidence
leg_verdict_rules.9_MECHANICAL: PASS if airframe verify_battery PASS and payload bay fits FC; FAIL on geometry/interference fail
leg_verdict_rules.10_REPORT_CARD: PASS when this card is complete with all legs + power_budget

functional_requirements.overall_status_rule: FAIL if any leg FAIL; WARN if no FAIL but any WARN or SKIP; PASS only if all legs PASS

power_budget.current_policy: Pull I_typ/I_max from datasheets or part-sourcing ledger notes at author time; unknown currents marked EST with needs_confirm — never silent zero

functional_requirements.evidence_policy: Cite sibling DL1–DL4 artifacts (verify_battery, interference, schematic/board/DRC, SPICE OP, antenna, ELF, Renode logs). Do not invent PASS.

verification_plan.pass_rule: all 10 legs present with exactly one allowed verdict each; power_budget rollup section present with numeric totals

assumptions: Overall status aggregation rule (FAIL>WARN/SKIP>PASS) is engineering judgment recorded on ledger
SPICE pass band fixed at 3.3 V ±5% per AC5
